plans.note: No standalone limitation-of-liability heading in the outline; any cap or damages disclaimer would most likely sit at the tail of the indemnity section (sec-12) or in an unlisted section. Check sec-12 for a damages exclusion before concluding the rule is missing.

Sec-12 is the indemnity clause. Verify TrueLink indemnifies Client for third-party IP and misconduct claims, and that Client's reciprocal indemnity (likely tied to sec-7 e-mail and sec-8 client covenants) stays narrow.
Restrictions on Client's business would appear as a licence-scope restriction (sec-2) or a Client covenant (sec-8); no dedicated non-compete heading appears.
In a hosting/licence deal exclusivity is usually embedded in the licence grant (sec-2) or Client covenants (sec-8); scan for 'sole', 'exclusive provider' language before marking missing.
Any most-favoured-pricing mechanic would sit in COMPENSATION (sec-5). Only flag if the MFN runs against us (best terms to TrueLink).
Employee non-solicits are often bundled with confidentiality (sec-10) or Client covenants (sec-8); no separate heading appears in the outline.

No term/termination section is listed (numbering gaps at 3, 4, 6, 9, 11 suggest unlisted sections). Confirm against the full document; if a termination clause exists, check Client's right to exit on notice without penalty.
Term/renewal mechanics are not in the supplied outline; look to any unlisted term section and to sec-5 for renewal price uplifts.
Governing law and venue normally sit in a general-provisions section not present in the outline; treat as absent unless the miscellaneous section surfaces.
No assignment or change-of-control heading in the outline; check any unlisted general-provisions section for consent requirements binding Client.
Ownership is likely addressed in the licence grant (sec-2) and defined terms (sec-1); confirm Client retains ownership of its content, customer data and marks, with confidentiality support in sec-10.
Sec-2 is the licence grant, read with the definitions in sec-1. Check scope for affiliates/contractors and for any at-will revocability or suspension right.
Usage or fee audits would attach to COMPENSATION (sec-5) or Client covenants (sec-8); no audit heading appears.
Watch sec-5 for late fees or penalties and sec-7 for per-message or fixed penalties tied to unsolicited e-mail obligations imposed on Client.
Sec-8 covers Client's warranties only; a TrueLink performance/hosting warranty would sit in an unlisted section (gaps at 9 or 11). If only a disclaimer exists, treat as missing vendor warranty.
No insurance heading in the outline; relevant because TrueLink hosts Client data, so raise as a gap unless an unlisted section covers it.
Any minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay would appear in COMPENSATION (sec-5); check for monthly minimums without an exit.
No termination/transition section listed; sec-10 may require return or destruction of confidential information, which is not a substitute for data return and migration assistance.
